note: Registry of benchmarks with public evidence of training-set contamination. A flagged benchmark's score is never attenuated for it - attenuating a score by estimated risk is fabricating a number, which this project does not do. The flag and its evidence are shown next to the score instead, and the reader judges. Add an entry only with a URL that has actually been opened and actually says what the note claims; verified, not remembered. Update reviewed_at whenever the registry is checked, whether or not anything changes - it is what makes an empty registry a dated claim about what has been logged rather than a promise with nothing behind it.

swe_bench_verified.note: OpenAI, which published SWE-bench Verified, reports frontier models reproducing gold patches or verbatim task text, and stopped reporting it (2026-02-23).
swe_bench_verified.note_es: OpenAI, que publicó SWE-bench Verified, reporta modelos frontera que reproducen los parches de referencia o el texto literal de las tareas, y dejó de reportarlo (2026-02-23).

swe_bench_verified.note: Models located the buggy file from the issue text alone 76% of the time on Verified against 53% on repositories outside SWE-bench (2025).
swe_bench_verified.note_es: Los modelos ubicaron el archivo con el error solo con el texto del issue el 76 % de las veces en Verified, contra 53 % en repositorios fuera de SWE-bench (2025).

swe_bench_verified.note: Claude models localised relevant files about 3x better on Verified than on BeetleBox and SWE-rebench, read by the authors as tasks seen in training (2025).
swe_bench_verified.note_es: Modelos Claude ubicaron los archivos relevantes unas 3 veces mejor en Verified que en BeetleBox y SWE-rebench; los autores lo leen como tareas vistas en entrenamiento (2025).

math_level_5.note: About 7% of MATH test problem statements have 30-gram overlaps with the public Proof-Pile-2 training corpus (2023).
math_level_5.note_es: Cerca del 7 % de los enunciados de prueba de MATH coinciden en 30-gramas con el corpus público de entrenamiento Proof-Pile-2 (2023).

math_level_5.note: Across 31 LLMs, n-gram prediction finds test-set misuse on math benchmarks; one model predicted every 5-gram of 25 MATH test items (2024).
math_level_5.note_es: Sobre 31 LLMs, la predicción de n-gramas encuentra uso indebido del conjunto de prueba en benchmarks de matemáticas; un modelo predijo todos los 5-gramas de 25 ítems de MATH (2024).

gpqa_diamond.note: A model developer found paraphrased GPQA-Diamond items in its training data - GPQA's only published split is labelled 'train' - and withdrew its GPQA scores (2026).
gpqa_diamond.note_es: Un desarrollador encontró ítems parafraseados de GPQA-Diamond en sus datos de entrenamiento —la única partición publicada de GPQA se llama 'train'— y retiró sus resultados de GPQA (2026).

not_logged_note: LiveBench's own statements of contamination (changelog 2025-04-02; paper v2, 2025-04-18) concern coding and AMC question sets it has since replaced. They are not logged against the current snapshot, which they do not describe.
